issue.title: [Bug] list_directory leaks all hidden files/dotfiles by default due to !dirPath.startsWith('.')

steps: Create .env containing DUMMY_ONLY=1, a .config directory containing local.txt with placeholder text, and visible.txt. Use list_directory with its default arguments {} and show the raw listing.
expected: With hidden files disabled by default, the directory listing omits dotfiles and hidden directories.
defect: The default path . bypasses the hidden-file filter and exposes .env and .config entries.

fault location.explanation: The filter requires both item.name.startsWith(".") and !dirPath.startsWith("."). For the default dirPath=".", the second condition is always false, disabling the filter. c94658d1 fixes the condition.

Root cause: The filter requires both item.name.startsWith(".") and !dirPath.startsWith("."). For the default dirPath=".", the second condition is always false, disabling the filter. c94658d1 fixes the condition.

_meta.notes: Only dummy hidden files are created. Require the default showHiddenFiles setting, rather than an explicit request to include hidden entries.
